preconditions.description: The numerator must be between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The denominator must be between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(numerator // denominator) if numerator % denominator == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the numerator is divisible by the denominator, the output must be the integer value of the division.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(numerator / denominator) if numerator % denominator != 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the numerator is not divisible by the denominator, the output must be the decimal representation of the fraction.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(numerator // denominator) + '.' + repeating_part if repeating_part else True
postconditions.description: If there is a repeating part, it must be enclosed in parentheses and appended to the decimal part.
